prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning beds/booths or spray (airbrush/solution) tans? I can recommend different salons depending on which you want and how close you need it to be.

If you just want a quick way to find the best salon near you, here’s a short checklist and an easy search plan you can use — or tell me your ZIP or neighborhood and I’ll give tailored suggestions.

How to pick the best tanning salon
- Decide type: UV beds vs spray tans (spray is safer; no UV exposure).
- Ratings & reviews: look for Google/Yelp ratings ≥4.0 and recent reviews that mention cleanliness and consistent results.
- Cleanliness & hygiene: beds/booths and spray areas should be well maintained; staff should provide disposable eyewear and clean linens.
- Staff training: technicians should do a consultation, explain skin-type limits, and offer a patch test for spray tans.
- Equipment & products: modern tanning systems (low-pressure beds with even bronzing) or reputable spray solutions (Norvell, Versa, Mystic).
- Safety practices: salons should ask about medications that increase photosensitivity and follow recommended exposure limits.
- Price & packages: compare single sessions vs packages or memberships for better value.
- Photos & results: look for before/after photos from actual clients in reviews or the salon’s social pages.

Quick search queries to use
- “spray tan near me Tyler TX” or “UV tanning salon Tyler TX”
- “best spray tan Tyler TX reviews” or “best tanning bed Tyler TX”
- On each result check Google/Yelp stars, scan recent reviews for consistency, and check Instagram for photos.

What to ask when you call or visit
- What spray tan solution do you use? (ask for brand)
- Do you do a patch test for first-timers?
- Are technicians certified/trained?
- How old is your equipment / when was it last serviced?
- What are the session lengths, prices, and package options?
- What hygiene measures do you follow between clients?

If you tell me your ZIP code or the part of Tyler you’re in and whether you prefer spray or UV, I’ll look up highly rated salons and give you 3–5 specific options with pros/cons.
